purpose: Consolidate the next evidence-backed mechanics frontier after restored-skill identity/acquisition recovery.
policy: Canonical skills.json remains authoritative. Research batches and audit artifacts are evidence layers. Source-reported numbers remain bounded by their source/version; unresolved frames, scaling, reward probabilities, and hidden gates remain null/unresolved.

records.name: Assault Rain
records.mechanics_boundary: Tracked aerial Ki-blast barrage; current evidence supports 10 hits, long range, launching behavior, and source-reported ~15% total damage.

records.name: Super Electric Strike
records.mechanics_boundary: Large tracked Ki wave; current evidence supports 17 hits, long range, knockback, and source-reported ~40% total damage.

records.name: Ki Explosion
records.mechanics_boundary: Short-range omnidirectional explosion; holding extends/repeats the explosion by consuming additional Ki, with current evidence allowing extension up to four Ki bars total. Official update history documents the historical 200→100 Ki change.

records.name: Heavenly Arrow
records.mechanics_boundary: Backward-moving 8-hit Ki barrage; forward input adds an unblockable Ki-powered hand strike and extra Ki bullet. Long-range/knockback behavior is documented.

records.name: Counter Burst
records.mechanics_boundary: Ki-specific counter that projects an energy shield and retaliates against applicable Ki Blast attacks.
unresolved: exact coverage of countered Ki attacks
